next_action: STEP 3 DONE: device blend WORKING on TT. Decision (Opus re-examine): abandoned the legacy fp32-CB-spill kernel (row>=8 corruption) and the raw-SFPU mb-major kernel (high risk) in favor of a clean DST-persistent fp32 full-tile kernel (alpha_blend_compute_dst_persistent.cpp): R/G/B/T live in fp32 DEST slots 0-3 for the WHOLE Gaussian loop, scratch 4-7, dst_full_sync_en=true (8 fp32 DEST tiles), inits once at top + mixed ops mid-acquire (pfwc pattern), no fp32 CB round-trip. MEASURED bh-30 30-view blend_mode=2 (now the DEFAULT device path, GSPLAT_TT_DST_PERSISTENT default ON): vs cpu_cpp_mb hero 63.89 / min 56.57 dB; vs GT hero 57.12 / min 50.61 dB (PASS: >40 hard floor, near 60 preferred; up from 26 dB bf16). blend=186ms (slow full-tile no-cull fp32; perf deferred per plan). screenshot opt/metal-screenshots/s3-dstpersist-default/hero.png. NEXT (step 4): project is now the dominant cost (~220ms/view, host-side pfwc+gather). Drive project -> full device residency (kill host DMA / gather), then tile_assign+sort on device, keeping data resident so blend pays no DMA. PSNR-gated only (no perf gate to ACCEPT a port). Then step 5 optimize to 1ms.
